state_matched_power_rh2m_pct.aggregation: mean of seven daily values in each Sunday-through-Saturday CDC week
state_matched_power_rh2m_pct.availability: source week ending Saturday marked available the following Saturday
state_matched_power_rh2m_pct.geography: 2020 Census mean center of population for each state/DC/Puerto Rico; Charlotte Amalie representative point for U.S. Virgin Islands; national is population-weighted across the 50 states and DC
state_matched_power_rh2m_pct.live_cadence_check: queried 2026-08-08; valid RH2M extended through 2026-08-06 (two-day lag)
state_matched_power_rh2m_pct.source_parameter: RH2M daily mean relative humidity at 2 meters
state_matched_power_rh2m_pct.vintage_control: current revised snapshot; no historical issued-vintage archive

wastewaterscan_flu_a_log10_pmmov.transform: within-site-week median log10(pcr_target_mic_lin + pseudocount), then national median across sites
